description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/Sales/FixedOrderLine. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Completes an exact order line that is in CompletedAutoOrderPending. ownerAgent: orders-autoordering. Domain: orders. Entity: order_line. Operation: complete_pending_autoorder. Scope: current_store. Use when: Use only for an exact order line whose current state is CompletedAutoOrderPending and the user confirms the corresponding visible Mark as Purchased action. Input: [FromBody] rq: LoadAddressesFromOrderLineRequest. Main fields: OrderLineIds: int[]. Required Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Output: Moves eligible CompletedAutoOrderPending lines to CompletedAutoOrder and returns refreshed order data. Search terms: sales fixedorderline. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

name: hgr_post_sales_fixedorderline
title: Post Sales Fixedorderline
